definitions.explanation: A cold dessert made of finely shaved ice topped with flavored syrup. A classic Japanese summer treat.

examples.japanese: かき{氷|ごおり}を{食|た}べたい。
examples.english: I want to eat shaved ice.

examples.japanese: イチゴ{味|あじ}のかき{氷|ごおり}を{注文|ちゅうもん}した。
examples.english: I ordered a strawberry-flavored shaved ice.

examples.japanese: {夏祭|なつまつ}りの{屋台|やたい}でかき{氷|ごおり}を{買|か}うのが{毎年|まいとし}の{楽|たの}しみだ。
examples.english: Buying shaved ice at the summer festival stalls is something I look forward to every year.

notes:
Also written as カキ{氷|ごおり} or {掻|か}き{氷|ごおり}. The {氷|こおり} reading changes to ごおり in this compound (rendaku).

COMMON FLAVORS:
- イチゴ: strawberry
- メロン: melon
- ブルーハワイ: blue Hawaii
- {宇治|うじ}{抹茶|まっちゃ}: Uji matcha
- {練乳|れんにゅう}がけ: with condensed milk

CULTURE: Shops selling かき{氷|ごおり} display a flag with the character {氷|こおり} in red on a white background. In recent years, gourmet かき{氷|ごおり} shops with {天然|てんねん}{氷|ごおり} (natural ice) have become popular.
